fixed_original_positive_gains_paired_exp.interpretation: Ablated terms remain positively configured and are deleted only by the named method; all other JAS gains are held fixed.

comparison_gains_calibrated_once_from_re.interpretation: No individual trajectory, truth, or online adjustment is used to retune either comparator.

completion_or_explicit_retained_terminat.interpretation: Explicitly recorded termination is a retained performance outcome, not by itself an invalid formula.

registered_initial_payload_pose_and_zero.note: Initial condition is checked against the registered scenario, not inferred from a successful later prefix.

all_tick_common_bounds_and_unclipped_sig.interpretation: Negative margins are retained. Common first-second bounds are an extra assessment requirement for original JAS.

native_control_envelope_is_distinct_and_.note: Saved successful commands must be inside their own control domain; common-margin violations remain permitted outcomes.

sampled_full_mujoco_held_torque_interval.note: Replay contacts/warnings are disclosed; their occurrence is a performance outcome.

sampled_torque_formula_and_exact_declare.interpretation: Only traditional transform, linear surface, linear reaching, or zero history coefficient changes in its named ablation; original prior-width sign remains.

original_local_momentum_filter_and_causa.interpretation: Original local six-dimensional filter only; no measured reaction or payload observation block.

original_raw_gram_ie_first_threshold_cro.trigger: lambda_min(raw Gram)>=omega, first local crossing at or after window; no target or normalized threshold.

constant_positive_configured_gain_and_ex.retained: Original -YS, causal filter, raw IE/frozen history and component projection for all five adaptive methods.

every_tick_complete_projected_euler_lear.projection: Original tangent blocking, then box-projected Euler step; no replaced history law.

theta_prior_box_and_projection_count_are.interpretation: Measured projection invariance is not evidence of an exponential parameter-error envelope.

offline_original_stored_residual_not_rem.interpretation: This is offline only. Nonzero history residual precludes an unconditional exact-truth exponential claim.

offline_newton_euler_balance_and_measure.interpretation: qacc and truth are validation only. Full reaction, including any contact/limit contribution, is retained and disclosed.

independent_entry_times_violations_and_t.interpretation: Entry must persist to the requested end for at least two seconds. Truncated trials are right censored.

raw_commands_and_exact_physical_torque_c.interpretation: Nonzero saturation is reported, never used to remove a sample or fail an otherwise correct physical clip.

desired_internal_force_and_logged_force_.units: Cartesian xyz N and generalized Euler-coordinate moments Nm are kept separate.

performance.phase_coordinate_semantics: Method-specific sliding variable and barrier coordinate; cross-structure ranking uses common physical tracking tolerances.

torque.interpretation: Raw command and physical clipped command both retained. Saturation is a performance outcome; incorrect clipping or omitted samples is a validation error.

theta.interpretation: Truth is evaluation-only. Box bounds and finite drift do not prove an exponential error envelope.

full.interpretation: Uniform saved-tick statistics, inclusive endpoints; AC removes only within-window mean. Cartesian force N and generalized Euler-coordinate moment Nm are reported separately; peaks are saved-tick peaks.

final_two_seconds.interpretation: Uniform saved-tick statistics, inclusive endpoints; AC removes only within-window mean. Cartesian force N and generalized Euler-coordinate moment Nm are reported separately; peaks are saved-tick peaks.

motion_after_two_seconds.interpretation: Uniform saved-tick statistics, inclusive endpoints; AC removes only within-window mean. Cartesian force N and generalized Euler-coordinate moment Nm are reported separately; peaks are saved-tick peaks.

performance.interpretation: Performance outcomes include every registered success, termination, violation and saturated tick; no method is required to outperform proposed by the validity audit.

scope: All saved ticks for FK, evaluation boundaries, entry and learning; sampled independently reconstructed control formulas and full-MuJoCo RK4 interval replay. Performance failure is retained separately. No continuous-time, global fixed-time, or exact-truth convergence certificate.
